{{Top|leg}}
'''Healing swatches''' were thick, pale green rectangles used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] to treat wounds. [[Vua Rapuung]] healed a [[Nang hul|thud bug]] wound sustained by [[Anakin Solo]], using a healing swatch.
